csv_row.description: Drafts a compliant Commercial Invoice for Export satisfying customs, banking (L/C), logistics, and insurance requirements. Enforces Incoterms 2020, HS tariff classification, country-of-origin determination, export control referencing, and certification language. Use when preparing export invoices for customs authorities, freight forwarders, banks, or insurance underwriters.
